messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in place, shifting her weight and turning her head and upper body slightly from side to side.","camera":"Static high-angle full-body shot from the front.","clothing":"Brown patterned sleeveless crop top, light gray wide-leg pants, and dark open-toed sandals.","hair_color":"Pink.","hairstyle":"Short hair with straight bangs and a small low ponytail at the back.","identity":"A slender female 3D character with a slim build and light skin.","scene":"An outdoor sandy or dirt ground with a long cast shadow, a low white wall at the upper left, and a colorful striped object at the upper right."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output is a static high-angle full-body shot of the character from the front, matching the reference framing. The character's clothing and general build are similar, but the scene is no longer the amusement park; it is a mostly empty sandy area with a low wall and a colorful object in the background. The original hair styling and the sequence of arm-raising and hair-touching actions are not preserved; she mostly stands with small head and body shifts.
arguments.requested_change: Change only the camera to a high-angle full-body shot from a front three-quarter view, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving the person's appearance, expression, action, existing scene, and action timing.
uncertain: Whether the character's facial expression was preserved, since the source face was mostly not visible from the back
unexpected_changes: Existing amusement park scene was replaced with a different open sandy area
Character's hairstyle changed from dark hair in low side buns to pink hair with straight bangs and a small low ponytail
Original action progression, including raising arms and touching hair, was not preserved
Character's visible action was reduced to standing with slight head and body shifts
